Their pursuit of this vision at any cost led to a violent civil war which nearly destroyed humanity itself, and in pursuit of their enemies fleeing this conflict, they found themselves lost in the Sirius Sector. The Battle Brothers have not relented however, and they go to any length to unite and uplift all of humanity. The Battle Brothers were created by a visionary scientist, known as the Founder, who used a series of gene-mods in order to enhance soldiers beyond their human limits. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken. ### Special Rules Lacerate: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Mend: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Re-Deployment: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Re-Position Artillery: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Shielded: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Unstoppable Mark: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply). Versatile Attack: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. ### Aura Special Rules Bane in Melee Aura: This model and its unit get Bane in melee. Bane when Shooting Aura: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Courage Aura: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Shrouding Aura: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rapid Rush Aura: This model and its unit get Rapid Rush. Regeneration Aura: This model and its unit get Regeneration. Versatile Reach Aura: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. Read more ### Spells Advanced Sight (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Cerebral Trauma (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and Lacerate. Blessed Ammo (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Shred when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Lightning Fog (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Protective Dome (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). Psychic Terror (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 9 hits with Bane. ### Units ### Heroes Master Destroyer [1] Qua 3+Def 3+ 145pts CCW(A4) Ambush, Battleborn, Fearless, Hero, Shielded,
